entity.name: Osita Sean Keluo-Udeke
entity.description: Maintainer of OBAAF (Open Build and Agent Assurance Framework), an open framework and toolchain for build-pipeline and AI-agent assurance.

projects.name: OBAAF
projects.description: An open framework and toolchain for build-pipeline and AI-agent assurance: bound the authority of AI agents in CI/CD, cryptographically attest every agent run, and catch workflow prompt injection. Includes a specification (R1-R8), a CLI (assess, check, attest, verify), reference GitHub Actions templates, and companion research papers.

plans.name: Support OBAAF
plans.description: General support for maintenance, the independent-studio pilot, and moving the framework toward a 1.0 release.
